description: Essential car care and maintenance tips for vehicle longevity and safety

items.title: Tire Pressure Check
items.description: Check tire pressure when tires are cold. Refer to door sticker for correct PSI. Low pressure wastes fuel and wears tires unevenly.

items.title: Windshield Washer Fluid
items.description: Check and top off windshield washer fluid. Use winter formula in cold climates to prevent freezing.

items.title: Exterior Light Check
items.description: Walk around car and verify all lights work: headlights, taillights, brake lights, turn signals.

items.title: Visual Tire Inspection
items.description: Look for cuts, bulges, embedded objects, or uneven wear patterns on all tires including spare.

items.title: Oil Level Check
items.description: Check engine oil with dipstick when engine is cool. Oil should be between min and max marks.

items.title: Coolant Level Check
items.description: Check coolant level in overflow tank when engine is cold. Never open radiator cap when hot.

items.title: Brake Fluid Check
items.description: Check brake fluid level in master cylinder reservoir. Low level may indicate brake wear.

items.title: Power Steering Fluid
items.description: Check power steering fluid level and condition. Dark or burnt smell indicates needed change.

items.title: Transmission Fluid Check
items.description: Check transmission fluid level and color (should be pink/red, not brown). Follow owner's manual procedure.

items.title: Air Filter Visual Check
items.description: Hold engine air filter up to light. Replace if you can't see light through it clearly.

items.title: Oil Change
items.description: Change engine oil and filter according to manufacturer schedule. Typically every 5,000-7,500 miles for synthetic.

items.title: Tire Rotation
items.description: Rotate tires every 5,000-8,000 miles for even wear. Front-to-back or cross pattern depending on drive type.

items.title: Air Filter Replacement
items.description: Replace engine air filter every 15,000-30,000 miles or as needed based on driving conditions.

items.title: Cabin Air Filter Replacement
items.description: Replace cabin air filter every 15,000-25,000 miles for clean air inside vehicle.

items.title: Brake Pad Inspection
items.description: Inspect brake pad thickness through wheel spokes. Replace when less than 3mm thick.

items.title: Spark Plug Replacement
items.description: Replace spark plugs per manufacturer schedule. Iridium/platinum last 60,000-100,000 miles.

items.title: Coolant Flush
items.description: Flush and replace coolant every 30,000-50,000 miles or per manufacturer recommendation.

items.title: Transmission Service
items.description: Change transmission fluid and filter per manufacturer schedule, typically every 30,000-60,000 miles.

items.title: Battery Check and Clean
items.description: Inspect battery terminals for corrosion. Clean with baking soda solution and apply protectant.

items.title: Wiper Blade Replacement
items.description: Replace wiper blades every 6-12 months or when they leave streaks or skip.

items.title: Winter Tire Swap
items.description: Install winter tires when temperatures consistently drop below 45°F for better traction.

items.title: Summer Tire Swap
items.description: Switch back to all-season or summer tires when temperatures consistently above 45°F.

items.title: AC System Check
items.description: Test air conditioning before summer. Weak cooling may indicate low refrigerant or other issues.

items.title: Heater and Defrost Check
items.description: Test heating and defrost before winter. Ensure quick and effective windshield clearing.

items.title: Winter Emergency Kit
items.description: Stock car with blanket, flashlight, jumper cables, ice scraper, sand/kitty litter for traction.

items.title: Exterior Wash
items.description: Wash exterior regularly to remove dirt, salt, and contaminants that damage paint.

items.title: Undercarriage Wash
items.description: Wash undercarriage especially after winter to remove salt that causes rust.

items.title: Interior Vacuum
items.description: Vacuum seats, floor mats, and carpet to remove dirt and debris.

items.title: Dashboard and Console Wipe
items.description: Clean dashboard, console, and door panels with appropriate cleaner.

items.title: Window Cleaning Inside
items.description: Clean interior windows for clear visibility and reduced glare.

items.title: Leather Conditioning
items.description: Apply leather conditioner to seats and surfaces to prevent cracking and fading.

items.title: Wax and Sealant Application
items.description: Apply wax or sealant after washing to protect paint from UV and contaminants.

items.title: Horn Test
items.description: Test that horn works properly for safety signaling.

items.title: Seatbelt Inspection
items.description: Check all seatbelts for smooth operation and secure latching.

items.title: Emergency Flashers Test
items.description: Verify hazard lights/emergency flashers work from both interior and exterior.

items.title: Jack and Tools Check
items.description: Verify spare tire, jack, and lug wrench are present and in working condition.

items.title: First Aid Kit Stock
items.description: Check and restock car first aid kit. Include bandages, antiseptic, and medication.

items.title: Registration Renewal Tracking
items.description: Track registration expiration and renew before deadline. Keep current registration in car.

items.title: Insurance Card Update
items.description: Replace expired insurance cards in vehicle with current versions.

items.title: Service Record Keeping
items.description: Maintain records of all maintenance and repairs for resale value and warranty.

items.title: Belt and Hose Inspection
items.description: Inspect serpentine belt and hoses for cracks, bulges, or wear. Replace preventatively.

items.title: Timing Belt/Chain Replacement
items.description: Replace timing belt per manufacturer schedule (typically 60,000-100,000 miles). Critical component.

items.title: Suspension Inspection
items.description: Check for worn shocks, struts, and bushings. Signs include bouncing, uneven tire wear, or noise.

items.title: Exhaust System Check
items.description: Inspect exhaust for rust, holes, or loose components. Listen for unusual sounds.

items.title: Wheel Alignment Check
items.description: Check wheel alignment annually or if car pulls to one side. Prevents uneven tire wear.

items.title: Track Fuel Economy
items.description: Monitor miles per gallon to detect early signs of engine or fuel system issues.

items.title: Remove Excess Weight
items.description: Clear trunk of unnecessary items. Extra weight reduces fuel efficiency.

items.title: Fuel System Cleaner
items.description: Add fuel system cleaner to tank every 3,000 miles to clean injectors and intake.

items.title: Diagnostic Code Check
items.description: Use OBD2 scanner to check for diagnostic trouble codes, especially if check engine light on.

items.title: Software Updates
items.description: Check for and apply any available vehicle software or infotainment updates.
